title: エンタープライズAIの普及
prompt:
[プロンプト内容]
A 3:4 vertical image illustrating the widespread adoption of enterprise AI. In the center,塾頭高崎翔太, a Japanese man in his early 30s with an energetic and approachable demeanor, is gesturing towards four distinct scenes surrounding him.
The first scene (top left) depicts a customer support setting with a friendly-looking AI agent avatar interacting with a diverse group of customers via various devices (laptops, tablets, phones).
The second scene (top right) shows robotic arms and digital displays interlinked, representing the fusion of RPA and AI for business automation. This section looks like an automated factory setting but with a touch of futuristic technology.

The overall tone of the image should be optimistic and forward-looking, visualizing how AI is transforming various aspects of enterprise operations.
